_README: Employers who have publicly committed to the Armed Forces Covenant, which
in many cases carries a GUARANTEED INTERVIEW SCHEME for veterans who meet
the minimum criteria for a role. Harry served two years as a Royal Navy
Communications and Information Specialist, so where such a scheme exists he
qualifies for it.
HOW THIS IS USED, AND THE RULE THAT KEEPS IT HONEST:
The email never asserts that a company holds an award or runs a scheme. It
asks - 'I am ex-Royal Navy, do you run a guaranteed interview scheme for
veterans?' - which is true whoever reads it and invites the answer either
way. A wrong entry in this file can therefore embarrass nobody and put no
false statement in Harry's name; it only decides who gets asked, and how
high they sit in the queue.
The Defence Employer Recognition Scheme publishes Bronze, Silver and Gold
award holders, and the Covenant publishes its signatory list:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/defence-employer-recognition-scheme
https://www.armedforcescovenant.gov.uk/
TO EXPAND THIS: search those lists for Aberdeen and Scotland, and add any
employer in Harry's trade. Every name added is a company where being
ex-forces moves him from the pile to the shortlist, which is worth more
than any number of extra cold emails.
'award' is what is publicly reported, and is informational only - nothing
in the code repeats it to an employer.
